gates.command: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1704067200 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python -m build --no-isolation --wheel --outdir dist_first; <repeat to dist_second>; compare sha256
gates.notes: KNOWN DEFECT (audit ENG-03): the compare step is explicitly NON-GATING (prints a note on mismatch). The downloaded exact-SHA wheels from run 42794427815 demonstrably differ (different _build_info.json / RECORD). A green reproducibility summary does not establish byte-identical builds. Also uses setuptools==79.0.1, a version the project's own security evidence rejected (ENG-10).

gates.notes: KNOWN DEFECT (audit ENG-13): the baseline-download step pins actions/download-artifact to the upload-artifact commit cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 (HTTP 422, no such commit); comparison is off by default on push/schedule; the comparison helper accepts wholly disjoint benchmark names and reports 'No significant changes detected'.

gates.command: python scripts/run_mutation.py --mode diff --base-sha <base>; python scripts/run_mutation.py --check-results mutation-results/summary.json
gates.notes: Diff-based mutation on changed safety-critical modules. A no-relevant-changes run writes a summary with skipped_reason=no-relevant-changes, which --check-results accepts (exit 0). Tracked baseline: 1697 entries.

gates.command: python scripts/run_mutation.py --mode full; python scripts/run_mutation.py --mode safety-critical; python scripts/run_mutation.py --check-results mutation-results/summary.json
gates.notes: Full + safety-critical mutation. Audit ENG-07: the full job is skipped on push events, so a green push check does not imply a full mutation campaign ran. The tracked baseline and its rationale do not imply all mutants were executed in a given push check.

gates.command: python -m pytest tests/fuzz/test_fuzz_pytest.py -v --tb=short; python scripts/run_fuzz.py --method direct --duration 5 --regression || true
gates.notes: KNOWN DEFECT (audit ENG-07): the direct-atheris step ends in `|| true`, and run_fuzz.py records an arbitrary nonzero child status as informational with error=null when no crash artifact is created, so a failed fuzz start can look clean. atheris is Linux-only (manylinux wheels); the workflow falls back to pytest mode when atheris is unavailable.

scope_of_this_record: This record freezes the starting point of wave W0 only. It records commands, identities and digests; it does NOT re-run any gate and it does NOT claim any gate passes. Gate verdicts belong to the evidence manifest (textforensics.evidence-manifest/v1) once scripts/verify_release.py exists. Known-broken states quoted above are audit-stated (docs/audits/2026-11-10/ENGINEERING.md, findings ENG-03/07/09/11/12/13/14), not re-measured by W0.
